comments.author: bushtail
comments.body_html:
Echoes was an abandoned project that got hashed out, a few people working on a few different things, 99% of it being done by another person

The reason why it looks like a scope with no icon is because that’s exactly what it is - item icons are generated from a snapshot of the actual 3D item - in this case the item is just a 45 degree scope that allows you to attach a regular scope/rings on top of it.

It’s possible to get at level 1, I just haven’t found out how to push it to a trader’s assort yet. I’ll look into it!
